name: Small Scale Lending Scheme (Microfinance)
benefit: **Loan Amount:** Maximum loan limit of ₹1,25,000/-. **Interest Rate:** Subsidized interest rate of 5% per annum. **Loan Coverage:** 95% of the project cost is covered through a loan. **Beneficiary Contribution:** Only 5% contribution is required from the beneficiary. **Target Group Support:** Specifically designed for small entrepreneurs from the Rabari and Bharwad communities.
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must belong to the Rabari and Bharwad castes among the socially and educationally backward classes. - The applicant must be aged between 21 to 45 years. - The applicant must have an annual income of less than or equal to ₹3,00,000/-.
